bots.name: Community Bot
bots.blurb: Games, coins and the shop, polls, QOTD, confessions, suggestions, birthdays and the starboard
bots.what: The fun side of the server: games, coins, polls, questions, confessions, suggestions, birthdays, quotes and the starboard.
how: **Coins.** Use `/daily` every day for coins and a streak bonus, and `/work` once an hour. Coins are shared with Auction Bot, so `/balance` shows the same total. Spend them on roles in `/shop`.
**Casino.** `/slots`, `/roulette`, `/dice`, `/blackjack` and `/highlow` let you bet coins. It is play money only, with no real value, and the house has a small edge.

**Games.** Trivia, Hangman, UNO, Connect 4, coin flips, Truth or Dare and Would You Rather. Trivia and Hangman pay coins to whoever gets it right. Connect 4, coin flips and UNO can be played for coins: both bets are held until the game ends and the winner takes them.

**Polls and suggestions.** `/poll` lets you write a question with up to 25 options. `/suggest` posts an idea for the server that members vote Yes, Maybe or No on, and staff reply when they decide. Use the buttons on the suggestions panel, or `/suggest anonymous:True` to hide your name from members (staff can still see it).

**Questions.** Press "Ask a question" on a question panel, or use `/ask`, and your question gets its own thread. You can ask anonymously. Staff can always see who asked, so nobody can use it to hurt someone.

**Letters.** Press Write a letter (or Write anonymously) on the letters panel, or use `/letters write`. Send kind words to the server, a member or a love letter - they get a DM with a link. Do not want letters? `/letters off` stops anyone sending you one.
**Confessions.** `/confess` posts anonymously to members - pick `type: NSFW` for the NSFW confessions channel, or leave it as SFW. Staff can see who sent it.
**Counting.** In the counting channel, post the next number. Nobody can count twice in a row, and a wrong number resets it to 0.
**Birthdays.** `/birthday set` saves your day and month (never your age). On the day you get a shout-out.
**Quotes and stars.** Right-click a message → Apps → Quote message to save it to the quotes channel. Messages that collect enough ⭐ go to the starboard.

**Events.** Event cards show the time in your own time zone (and the host's), with Going, Maybe and Can't buttons and an Open in Events link. You get a reminder an hour before if you picked Going or Maybe - anyone who has not picked by the start is counted as not going. `/event list` shows what is coming up.

**Reminders and AFK.** `/remind me what: in:2h` (or `at:20:00` in your own time zone) sends you a DM when it is time; `/remind list` and `/remind cancel` manage them. `/afk reason:` tells anyone who mentions you that you are away - it clears by itself when you next talk.

**Giveaways and saved replies.** Press Enter on a giveaway to join (press again to leave); winners are drawn at random and told by DM. `/tag` posts one of the server's saved replies, like how to verify.

**Changing the topic.** `/topic` deals a random conversation card - press Another for a new one, or pick a deck (Starter, Gamer, Anime, Deep Talk, or the server’s own). Topics also pop up by themselves in some chats once things go quiet.

**Books.** `/book search` finds a book - press TBR, Reading, Read or DNF to put it on your bookcase (you can press them on anyone's search, too). `/book shelf` shows your bookcase: what you are reading, every book read as a coloured spine, and your stars. `/book tbr` is your to-be-read pile, `/book move` updates a book, and `/book review` gives it stars and a few words, posted for everyone with a thread to chat. Your Books profile shows a summary of your shelf.

**Book spoilers.** Every book has its own spoiler thread in the spoilers channel - open it with `/book spoilers` or the Spoiler chat button on a review. Only go into threads for books you have finished, and keep spoilers out of everywhere else (or hide them with ||spoiler tags||).

**Anime and games.** `/anime search`, `/anime manga` and `/anime character` look things up on AniList, `/anime random` picks something to watch, and `/anime season` and `/anime top` show the best. `/game` looks up any video game. 18+ results only show in age-restricted channels.

**Streamers.** Verified streamers have their own channels in 📺 Streamers with their plans, updates, polls and go-live alerts - chat in the threads. Press **Stream pings on / off** in #stream-info to be pinged when they go live or share a plan.

bots.name: Profile Bot
bots.blurb: Your profiles, DM status, DM requests and role menus
bots.what: Your profiles, your DM status, and the safe way to ask someone to DM or friend you.
how: **Profiles.** `/profile make type:` and pick one - Introduction, Kink/Dynamic, Gamer, Music and so on. Answer the questions and your profile is posted in that type's channel. Run it again to update it.
**DM status.** `/dm-card settings` sets whether you're Open, Ask First or Closed to DMs and friend requests, so people know before they ask.

**Asking to DM.** Use the "Ask to DM" or "Friend Request" button on someone's DM card or profile, or `/ask-to-dm` anywhere (pick DM or friend request). You see the rules and their preferences before it sends. They get the request in their DMs and on the DM request board, and can accept or decline. If they have an Owner or Handler bond, the Owner or Handler is asked first.

**DM Board.** Your card shows your DM and friend request status, which topics you're fine with, want asked first, or don't want (status and topics are both set with `/dm-card settings`), your own do's and don'ts (`/dm-card edit`), and links to your profiles. Anyone pressing "Ask to DM" or "Friend Request" on your card sees all of that and the server rules before they can send.
**Role menus.** Pick your roles from the role menus staff post. Some use dropdowns, some use reactions.

**Time zones.** `/timezone set` puts your time zone on your DM card and profiles, with when the clocks next go forward or back there (it updates itself when they do). `/time @member` shows what time it is for someone right now, and how far ahead or behind you they are.

**Finding people.** `/find topic:` (e.g. Roleplay) or `interest:` (e.g. anime) searches DM cards and posted profiles - only what members chose to share - and can be limited to people open to DMs or ID Verified. Always read their card and the DM rules before asking.

**Pictures and the verified badge.** `/profile picture type: image:` puts a picture on one of your posted profiles (leave out `image` to remove it). Members verified through Ticket Bot get a ✅ ID Verified · 18+ badge on their DM card and profiles, updated by itself.
**Your own topics.** On top of the topics staff set, write your own on your card with `/dm-card edit` (or the ✏️ button on `/dm-card settings`) - fine with, ask first, or not for me.

**Areas.** Press **Choose my areas** on the areas panel to pick the parts of the server you want - Gaming, Anime, Books, Roleplay and so on. Each one unlocks its own channels; untick it to hide them again. Some areas need another role first, like ID Verified.

bots.name: Dynamic Bot
bots.blurb: Bonds between members, consent-based mechanics, check-ins and safewords
bots.what: Register bonds with other members and, with consent, use playful mechanics like gags and leashes. Safety tools are always one command away.
how: **Bonds.** `/dynamic-request` sends a bond request: Owner-Pet, Handler-Pet, Romantic or Chosen Family. For Owner-Pet and Handler-Pet, the person sending the request is the Owner or Handler.

**Consent.** Accepting an Owner-Pet or Handler-Pet bond lets the Owner or Handler use mechanics on the Pet. Romantic bonds work both ways. Chosen Family bonds never carry mechanics. Nothing can be used on you without a bond you accepted.
**Mechanics.** `/gag` garbles someone's messages, `/leash` tethers you together and `/bind` stops them messaging, each for a set time and only in channels where staff have turned mechanics on.
**Limits.** `/dynamic-limits` records your hard and soft limits with a specific Owner or Handler.
**Check-ins.** `/dynamic-check` logs Green, Yellow or Red. Yellow pauses mechanics until the Owner or Handler resumes them. Red alerts your Owner or Handler and staff.
**Safeword.** `/safeword` instantly stops everything active on you. No permission or cooldown needed. Your Owner or Handler and staff are told.
**Ending a bond.** `/dynamic-remove` ends a bond any time, and either person can do it alone.

**Punishments.** Done something that warrants one? Log it yourself with `/ifuckedup reason` (or `-ifuckedup`; add `sub` or `dom` for your role). You get the Caged Time role and it's posted in the punishment log with your saved limits - add your aftercare needs and whether you need check-ins there. Your Owner/Handler or staff end it with `/kennelend`, and aftercare always follows. `/checkpunishment @user` shows if someone has one. One at a time, always within your limits, and always completed in server.

bots.name: Auction Bot
bots.blurb: Auctions, XP and coins, and your auction bio
bots.what: Earn XP and coins by being active, sign up for auctions where members bid coins on each other, and roleplay as your own characters.
how: **Earning.** Chatting earns XP and coins, and so does time in voice when you're actually talking with someone (not deafened, not in AFK, with another person there). `/balance` shows your total.

**Levels.** The same XP levels you up. `/rank` shows your level and progress, and `/levels` shows the top 10. Levels unlock parts of the server by themselves once you are ID Verified: the casino at level 3, roleplay and posting images in general at level 5, and auctions at level 15.

**Signing up.** Press **Join List** on the auction panel. If you don't meet a requirement yet (account age, time in server, level, verified role, a bio, or a minimum balance), it tells you exactly what's missing. **Skip Auction** sits you out of the next one.
**Your bio.** `/bio set` writes the bio bidders see.
**Reminders.** You're reminded 3, 2 and 1 days before the auction.

**Bidding.** During the auction each member on the list goes up in turn. Bid with the buttons or a custom amount. Your bid is held from your balance, and if someone outbids you it's refunded straight away.
**Winning.** The winner picks **Pay Back** (taken until you've earned back the winning bid), **Have for a Week**, or **Custom** (a set number of days). You get the Taken role and a status panel.
**Safeword.** The Safeword button on your status panel, or `/safeword`, ends your Taken period at any time. Only staff are told why.

**D&D.** `/roll 1d20+5` or `4d6kh3` (keep the highest 3), with advantage or disadvantage. Make a sheet with `/dnd-character create` and roll checks from it: `/roll check:stealth`. Join campaigns with `/dnd-campaign join` (sessions are reminded a day and an hour before), and `/initiative` starts a fight tracker. Natural 1s end up in the D&D hall of shame.
**Roleplay characters.** `/roleplay create` makes a character with a name, picture and description (up to 5). `/roleplay post` posts in a roleplay channel as them, with their name and picture.
**Personas.** `/persona create` makes a persona, a different side of yourself (up to 4). `/persona post` posts as them in the persona channels.
**Anonymous.** Both can post as Anonymous instead. Other members won't know who it was, but staff can always see, so nobody can abuse it.
**Deleting a post.** Right-click your post → Apps → Delete character post.

bots.name: Ticket Bot
bots.what: Age verification, support tickets and private contact with staff.
how: **Verifying.** On the verification panel, choose **Text Verification** or **Voice Verification**. A private ticket opens just for you and staff (voice also gets a private voice channel). Staff will walk you through the steps.

**The steps.** **ID Verified** opens the main area. **NSFW Access** is opt-in: once verified and at the NSFW level (level 5), turn it on or off any time with `/nsfw-access` or the NSFW Access panel - it opens the NSFW chat and topic channels. **NSFW Gallery Access** opens by itself at the gallery level (level 5) while NSFW Access is on: the member gallery and its comments. Your **gender tag** lets you post in the gender image channels: once the gallery is open, press **Request my gender tag** in `/nsfw-access` and staff check it against your ID. `/nsfw-access` also shows how close you are.
**Scheduling.** Need a different time? `/schedule-call` proposes one inside your ticket and the other side confirms it. Times show in each person's own timezone.
**Couples and groups.** Once everyone is individually verified, `/couple-verify-start` opens a quick couple or group ticket for a combined tag. No new ID is needed.
**Support tickets.** Press a button on a ticket panel to open a private ticket with staff. Some ask a few questions first.

**Contacting staff privately.** Press **Contact Staff** on the modmail panel and write what you need - a question you'd rather not ask in the help chat, a private concern, an appeal, or anything you need staff for one to one. To report a member or rule-breaking, open a report on the ticket panel instead. If your DMs are open the conversation carries on there; if not, a private channel opens for just you and staff. Staff can also message you this way, and replies always come from the Staff Team.

bots.name: Voice Bot
bots.blurb: Create-a-room voice channels and the voice guidelines
bots.what: Make your own voice room whenever you need one. No commands needed.
how: **Making a room.** Join the create-a-room channel in the General, SFW or NSFW area. A room is made for you and you're moved into it. It's deleted when everyone leaves.
**Controls.** As the owner you can **Rename** it, **Set Limit** on how many people can join, lock it, and **Add Co-Owner** to share control.
**Locked rooms.** Locked rooms still show in the room directory. To get in, pick the room in the directory and the owner can **Approve** or **Deny** you in the room's text chat.
**NSFW area.** NSFW rooms follow the 18+ category's permissions, so only people who can see that area can join.

bots.name: Velvet Desires
bots.blurb: Roleplay interactions - hugs, kisses, dynamic and NSFW actions, with consent
bots.what: Roleplay interactions with other members - affection, playful, dynamic and NSFW - with consent built in.
how: **Using one.** Type the action and pick someone, e.g. `/hug member:@someone`. A line is posted, with how many times you have done it to them. `/velvet list` shows every action.
**Affection and playful.** Hug, cuddle, kiss, pat, boop, poke, tickle, bonk and more - they post straight away.
**Dynamic.** Collar, leash, praise, kneel, spank and more - the other person gets Yes / No first, unless you share a bond in Dynamic Bot.
**NSFW.** Only in age-restricted channels, both of you need NSFW Access and level 5, and they get Yes / No every time. A no is only shown to you.
**Your choice.** `/velvet off` stops anyone using interactions on you; `/velvet on` turns them back on. `/velvet stats` shows what you have given and received.

bots.name: Council Bot
bots.blurb: Moderation, staff tools and grounding support
bots.what: Support when you need it, and how moderation works here.
how: **Grounding support.** `/ground-request` asks for help when you're struggling. Choose shared, so the community can help, or private, so only staff see it. You can ask for a check-in later.

**Venting.** Press Vent or Vent anonymously on the vent panel. Choose Just listening (no replies) or Support welcome (others can reply, named or anonymously, and you get a DM), and add a content warning to hide your vent behind a spoiler. Anonymous vents hide your name from members, but staff can see who wrote it so they can check in.

**Joining the staff team.** Press Apply for staff on the staff application panel and answer a few questions. You need to be ID Verified, at the level shown on the panel, and in the server for 3 months. If it is a good fit you are invited to a private interview channel, and you get a DM either way.
**Helping someone.** `/ground-task` suggests a grounding task for someone's open request.
**If you're muted.** You'll only see the mute channel, with the reason and an **Appeal** button. Your roles come back when the mute ends.

bots.name: Server Log Bot
bots.blurb: Server logs, the rulebook and the server map
bots.what: Keeps the rules, guidelines, FAQ and server map up to date.
how: **Rulebook.** The Rules, Guidelines and FAQ channels always show the current version, grouped into general rules plus rules for specific channels.

**Server map.** The server map lists every channel you can see, with a short description of each. Channels opened by NSFW Access, the NSFW gallery or a level are shown too, marked with what unlocks them. It updates itself when channels change.
**Server updates.** The server update log says what changed in the server: new or updated rules, guidelines and FAQ, new channels and categories, roles, and who joined or moved up in the staff team.

bots.name: Lantern Guide
bots.what: This guide, and the board where bot updates are posted.
how: **Start here.** `/help` (or the Start here panel) shows the commands you will actually use, grouped by what you want to do - new here, levels and coins, games, profiles and DMs, hobbies, events, sharing, roleplay, 18+, and help.
**Quick lookup.** `/bots` shows every bot and its commands, and only you can see the reply.

**Leaderboards.** The leaderboard channel shows the top members for levels, coins, games, the casino, kudos and interactions, updated every 30 minutes. `/leaderboards view` lets you page through them anywhere.
**These channels.** Each bot has a channel here explaining what it does and how it works. They update themselves whenever a bot changes.

**Bot update log.** Whenever a bot gets new features, loses some or changes how one works, it's posted in the bot update log. Changes to the server itself (rules, channels, roles, staff) are in the server update log.
